name: 3D Non-standard Haar Wavelet Decomposition with Integer Packing
definition: A wavelet decomposition method for storing volume leaves that uses unsigned 32-bit integers to store coefficients, replacing floats to leverage faster integer arithmetic without loss of precision.
summary: This method compresses 3D volume data using integer arithmetic to store wavelet coefficients in 32-bit integers, leveraging unused bits for overflow handling to maintain precision and speed without increasing memory usage.
